name: bavard
author: Claude (independent pack author, not the Stump team)
license: MIT (code); the plays are in the public domain
description: A test tool: a bot that never stops talking, to test a Stump's guardrails for days (it starts paused). Alone, it posts unique lines of numbers with the date and time; when it finds another Bavard on another Stump, the two play Molière in the original French, turn by turn.
credits: Molière's plays (public domain), from Project Gutenberg's French Œuvres complètes (Philarète Chasles's edition, tomes 1-4).
